source_roster.representative_unit_rule: For each physical site, among catalog-passing units with positive frozen AEI support, choose the unit with the lowest early Landsat scene count; break ties by unit_id. Pixel support is then inherited by every candidate species unit at that physical site.

per_site_rule.scene_year_selection: one lowest-scene-cloud acquisition per year, then up to five years nearest evenly spaced quantiles across the frozen site-specific epoch
per_site_rule.site_pass: both early and late Landsat epochs pass exactly the same rule used in the 14-site pilot

technical_execution.rule: Sharding is computational only and cannot change site eligibility, scene selection, thresholds, or epochs.
technical_execution.technical_query_or_read_failures: report separately; do not reclassify as ecological support failure

continuation_gate_after_full_qa.regional_replication: at least two regions with >=5 eligible physical sites
continuation_gate_after_full_qa.next_if_passed: freeze and validate habitat-change classifier, including Beaufort positive-direction control, before joining demographic magnitudes
continuation_gate_after_full_qa.failure_action: stop dynamic terrestrial lane without relaxing thresholds and move to emperor dynamic-substrate lane

prohibited_changes: adding rescue scenes after seeing population outcomes
changing site-specific optical epochs using demographic values
excluding sites based on abundance trend, concentration, persistence, or extinction
